item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena fills a tall plastic bottle completely with water and closes the cap tightly.
She then makes a small hole in the side wall of the bottle, near the bottom.
What does Meena observe, and what does it show about the pressure exerted by water?

options.A: No water comes out, because water pushes only downward on the bottom of the bottle
options.B: Water flows out through the hole, showing that water also pushes on the side walls of the bottle
options.C: No water comes out, because the cap is closed and air cannot enter the bottle
options.D: Water flows out only if the bottle is squeezed, showing that water does not push on the side walls by itself
